title: messaging canned catalog entries bypass byte cap at construction; exact 1024/1025 boundary untested
description: _normalize_canned_catalog validates id/text types but not MESSAGES_MAX_BODY_SIZE on entry text - oversized catalog entry is accepted then permanently unpostable (runtime 4.00 per POST). Add constructor-time byte validation (fail fast) + exact-boundary tests: canned text exactly 1024 bytes -> CREATED, 1025 -> 4.00.
close_reason: _normalize_canned_catalog now enforces MESSAGES_MAX_BODY_SIZE on entry text at construction, raising ValueError('canned message text must be at most 1024 bytes') mirroring the existing malformed-catalog ValueError conventions; oversized entries can no longer be accepted-then-unpostable. Tests in TestMessageBodySizeCap: exact 1024-byte canned text posts CREATED; 1025-byte entry rejected at construction (ValueError); multibyte 1200-byte entry rejected at construction; runtime post-expansion 4.00 guard retained and now tested as defense-in-depth with injected 1025-byte text (no mutation). Updated two tests that encoded the old accept-at-contract (canned_expansion_over_cap -> construction rejection / injected-guard runtime 4.00; canned_multibyte_over_byte_cap -> construction rejection).
